entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more a matter of preference with the helmet?
The color. It's not what I expected. The box is still unopened, if that matters.

I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, I see the purchase was made 56 days ago. That's perfectly within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Great. So you'll take it back.

Absolutely. Your safety is our priority, and we want you to be completely satisfied with gear as crucial as a helmet. I can process this return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label.

And Alex, I see here you're one of our VIP members. To thank you for your loyalty and for the inconvenience, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase. You should see that reflected immediately.
Of course. The email with the return label is on its way to you now. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
